name: Knowledge, Virtue, and Ontotheology: a Kierkegaardian (Self-)Critique.
headline: Knowledge, Virtue, and Ontotheology: a Kierkegaardian (Self-)Critique.
description: The article examines philosopher Soren Kierkegaarde's views on faith with regard to ontotheology, virtue, and knowledge. Several methods used by Kierkegaarde to discuss faith as an ethical state are explored to illustrate that they can be examined based on the virtue tradition. Also discussed are the continental tradition in philosophy, the philosophy of religion (PoR), and mashup PoR.
